title: Grafana Metrics (Placeholder - Import from Grafana.com or create custom)
description:
This is a placeholder dashboard. To enable:
1. Uncomment grafana job in prometheus.yml.j2
2. Import dashboard from Grafana.com
3. Or create custom dashboard using Grafana metrics
4. Recommended metrics:
   - Dashboard load times: grafana_dashboard_*
   - Datasource queries: grafana_datasource_*
